docs.title: Welcome to the RANGER Group webpage
docs.text:
The Regulation & Genome Evolution Research group focuses on understanding the dynamic gene expression of proliferative stages and tissues in organisms across the tree of life. The group was established in 2024 at the Ruđer Bošković Institute (RBI) within the Laboratory for Computational Biology and Translational Medicine, Division of Computing and Data Science.

At EMBO Scientists’ Forum (ESF) 2026 in Sheraton Dubrovnik Riviera Hotel [October 28-30, 2026].

Group retreat in Zagreb.
